_about: Public-domain James H. Brookes (James Hall Brookes, 1830-1897, Presbyterian, St. Louis, father of the Niagara Bible Conference) for the Word Hoard: 10 books from Internet Archive scans, among them The Way Made Plain (1871), Maranatha (fifth edition, 1878), The Mystery of Suffering, Chaff and Wheat (1891) and Till He Come (1891). Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 22 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
